نتناقص (form VI)
# نَتَنَاقَصُ (natanāqaṣu) /na.ta.naː.qa.sˤu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَنَاقَصَ (tanāqaṣa)
# نَتَنَاقَصَ (natanāqaṣa) /na.ta.naː.qa.sˤa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَنَاقَصَ (tanāqaṣa)
# نَتَنَاقَصْ (natanāqaṣ) /na.ta.naː.qasˤ/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَنَاقَصَ (tanāqaṣa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
